# Privacy Policy — SceneView

The canonical privacy policy is **<https://sceneview.github.io/privacy.html>** (source:
[`website-static/privacy.html`](../website-static/privacy.html)). It is the page both app
stores link to. Edit that file, not this one.

In short:

- **SceneView SDK** — collects nothing: no analytics, no crash reporter, no server.
- **SceneView Demo app** (Android and iOS) — Firebase Analytics (usage events), Crashlytics
  (crash reports) and Cloud Messaging (notifications you allow). No accounts, no ads, no
  advertising identifier, no tracking. Opt-out in the app's Settings. On Android, the Cloud
  Anchors and Geospatial demos use Google ARCore cloud services, which process camera and
  location data to power those sessions.
- **Website** — Google Analytics 4 page views, skipped under Do Not Track / Global Privacy
  Control.

Contact: thomas.gorisse@gmail.com · <https://github.com/sceneview/sceneview/issues>
